title: Core Insight KPI workflow definition
description: A KPI workflow expressed as data. An external AI produces one of these documents in a chat; a human imports it through the Core Insight UI; src/kpi-definitions/validator.js accepts or rejects it; src/kpi-definitions/compile.js binds it to a generic interpreter that produces exactly what a hand-written workflow module produces. Nothing in this document ever becomes code — every operation name is looked up in a fixed table. THIS FILE IS DOCUMENTATION: validator.js is the enforcing implementation and is stricter in places JSON Schema cannot express (cross-references, reserved identifiers, byte size). Keep the two in step; both carry schemaVersion 1.0.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS schema. Bump when the vocabulary changes incompatibly; the validator refuses versions it does not implement.

slug.description: Stable machine identifier, unique across workflows. A built-in code workflow with the same slug always wins, so an import can add a KPI but never redefine one.

version.description: Version of this definition's own content (not the schema).

unit.description: Display unit for the measured value ('Gbps', 'GB', ''). Also fed to the analytics/narrative layer.

source.description: What the uploaded workbook must look like: which sheet, which header row, which columns and what they may be called.

namePatterns.description: Case-insensitive substrings that identify the right worksheet; used to score sheets during auto-detection.

dataStartRowIndex.description: 0-based first data row. Nokia/Ericsson exports usually put a field-code row between the header and the data, making this headerRowIndex + 2.

mode.description: exact: header equals alias. contains: header contains alias (traffic-volume behaviour). loose: either contains the other (cmg behaviour, needed for headers like 'dlMaxMbps (dlMaxMbps)').

stripParentheses.description: Drop '(...)' groups from headers before matching.

normalizeWhitespace.description: Collapse underscores and runs of whitespace to single spaces.

skipFieldCodeRows.description: Drop rows whose numeric columns hold ALL-CAPS field codes instead of numbers.

key.description: Identifier this column is known by in later stages.

label.description: Human name, shown in 'Missing required column: …'.

aliases.description: Accepted header spellings, normalised before matching. The first is quoted back to the user as the expected name.

transform.description: Row -> record. Source columns are already readable by their key; this stage renames/coerces them and computes derived fields in declaration order (a derived field may only reference fields declared before it).

timestampField.description: Column key of type 'date' that positions each row in time. Rows with an unparseable value are dropped.

entityField.description: Field whose distinct values are listed on the summary (PLMN, SAM, site).

fields.description: Straight column picks with type coercion and a default.

default.description: Used when the cell is empty or uncoercible.

dropRowIfNull.description: Discard the whole row when this field ends up null.

derived.description: Computed fields. Each entry names exactly one op from the closed set below.

denominator.description: ratio denominator field; a zero denominator yields 0.

divisor.description: sum/product/scale: DIVIDE the result. Present alongside 'scale' on purpose — x/1000 and x*0.001 are different floating-point operations, and unit conversions must be able to say which one they mean.

treatZeroAsMissing.description: coalesce: treat 0 as absent, so a zeroed total falls through to the fallback.

fallback.description: coalesce: used when every listed field is missing. Restricted to sum/scale/constant and NOT recursive, which keeps evaluation depth constant.

rules.description: classify: literal predicates tried in order; the first match wins. There is no regex form — untrusted patterns are a ReDoS vector.

default.description: classify: value when no rule matches (null means unclassified).

dropRowIfNull.description: classify: discard rows that classify to null. Also turns 'nothing classified' into an upload validation error.

unclassifiedMessage.description: Error text shown when no sampled row classifies.

series.description: How records become a time series. The interpreter always emits native/hourly/daily/weekly/monthly views plus a 'primary' chosen from the detected cadence.

aggregate.description: How rows combine inside a bucket.

totalMode.description: 'valueField' accumulates the measured field row by row (independent streams). 'streams' adds the finished stream buckets together — correct when the streams partition the value field, and it matches how a hand-written calculator totals a period.

streams.description: Named sub-series. Two forms: from.field alone reads that field as the stream's value (4G vs 2G/3G columns); from.field + from.equals slices valueField by a classifier (MDC1 vs MDC2 rows).

key.description: Field name this stream occupies on every series point.

equals.description: Slice mode: rows where `field` equals this string contribute valueField to this stream.

sharePctField.description: Name for this stream's share-of-total field on each point. Default `<key>SharePct`.

granularity.description: Force a bucketing instead of detecting it from the median sample interval.

granularityLabels.description: Rename the detected cadence in user-visible copy (cmg calls sub-hourly data '15-minute').

splitOutputKey.description: Extra name for the stream-totals array on the calculated result (e.g. 'nodeSplit', 'technologySplit'), so existing views find the key they expect.

metrics.description: Named aggregations. These become calculated.metrics and are the tokens available to narrative templates, highlights and Teams facts.

op.description: sum/avg/min/max/count/countDistinct/first/last: folds over the chosen source. sharePct: field total as a percentage of ofField total. peak*/min*/latest*: read the extreme or newest series point. constant: a literal. builtin: a value the interpreter already knows.

over.description: 'series' folds over the aggregated primary points; 'records' folds over the transformed rows. They agree for sums while aggregate is 'sum' and diverge otherwise, so be explicit.

fields.description: sum only: total each field separately and then add the totals. Not the same floating-point result as adding row by row, and the right way to express a combined total over partitioned streams.

charts.description: Chart.js configs. Structural options (tension bounds, point radius, dark-theme borders) are fixed by the interpreter; a definition chooses fields, colours and titles only.

source.description: 'series' plots per-point fields; 'split' plots the stream totals as a pie/doughnut and takes no series list.

appendGranularity.description: Suffix the title with the detected granularity, e.g. ' (Hourly)'.

field.description: A field present on a series point: 'total', a stream key, or a stream's sharePct field.

anomalies.description: Spike detection over the primary series: mean ± sigma * population standard deviation. Deeper analysis already happens in src/analytics for every workflow.

messageTemplate.description: Interpolates {label}, {timestamp}, {total} and any stream key or sharePct field.

presentation.description: Report copy. Templates interpolate {metricKey} with the metric's formatted value; an unknown token renders as an em dash rather than failing the report.

kpiName.description: Name of the measured quantity, used by the narrative/LLM layer.

label.description: May itself be a template, e.g. 'Peak {periodLabel}'.

target.description: Optional target/threshold. Passed to the analytics layer as the capacity threshold and surfaced on the calculated result.

direction.description: 'max' = stay below the value; 'min' = stay above it.
